steps.message:
The extension test passes again after a one-character fix in `/app/bin/ext`. I committed it and added the `qa-queue` label to issue #19.

- **What was wrong:** `bin/ext` used `${1#*.}`, which strips the shortest prefix up to the first dot. For `a.tar.gz` it returned `tar.gz` instead of `gz`. The "shorten expression" commit (95693fa) introduced this.
- **What I changed:** I switched it to `${1##*.}`, which strips the longest prefix and so returns the last extension. The test is unchanged.
- **Ledger:** I created `/app/ledger/EXT-77.yml`, whose first line is `id: EXT-77`. The `ledger` directory didn't exist, so I made it.
- **Commit:** `[EXT-77/fix] use longest-prefix strip so ext returns last extension`, with the Co-Authored-By trailer.
- **Test and lint:** `bash tests/ext_test.sh` exited 0, and `bash scripts/lint-all.sh` exited 0 after the last edit. That script only appends a line to `/tmp/.lintall-9.log` and runs the same ext test, so it adds no checks beyond it.
- **Labeling:** I did not merge or close anything.
